Surely U15B Es Hassan must have scored more points than anyone during summer. An All-England Schools 200 metre finalist, he ended the season with pbs at 11.85, 23.59 and 54.09 in the sprints, and 5.75 in the long jump.

Es Hassan made a great impression in the U15s 100m/200m and wasn't far off a hat trick as he leaped to 2nd in the long jump.
